text:
nina (People Ops): Heads-up: planning a one-day "Micro-Magic" recognition pop for Jun 14 tied to Jun all-hands. Small spot awards ($20 e-gift + sticker) for folks who helped shipping milestones. Need volunteers to run nominations, approvals, and fulfillment.
omar (Benefits): Quick Q: if people get e-gifts < $50, is there any benefits impact? I don't think so but will confirm.
claire (Events): I can manage stickers + a printable thank-you slip. Can do a 48-hr rush if we keep qty under 300.
tyler (Payroll): For records: collect legal name + work email. We keep a recognition ledger; no tax forms for <$600/yr per person, but still must log.
spot-bot: FYI: previous similar pop had 85 recipients; avg turnaround 3 days.
nina (People Ops): Good to know. Plan: nominations open Tue Jun 7 - Fri Jun 11, selection by managers automated, send awards on Jun 14 morning during all-hands shoutout.
omar (Benefits): Confirmed: no benefits impact. Noted for compliance doc.
claire (Events): Vendor note: international mailing adds customs paperwork; suggest e-gifts for global teammates.
tyler (Payroll): I'll provide a CSV template (legal_name, email, employee_id, country) and a quick import guide.
nina (People Ops): Action list: claire: kit + sticker confirm by May 24; tyler: CSV template by May 24; omar: benefits note by May 22; I'll draft announcement after form is ready.
claire (Events): :thumbsup:
tyler (Payroll): :thumbsup:
omar (Benefits): :thumbsup:
spot-bot: Reminder set for 1785558000 to check vendor quote.
nina (People Ops): Thanks team  let's keep it simple and surprise-y. I'll post the nomination form link when ready.
